  hex-digits = head+foot,
  range-end = FF,
]{ec-qhvr}

\newpage

\section{Latin Modern Sans --- OTF font}

\displayfonttable[
  %              missing-glyph = \tiny\setlength\fboxsep{0pt}\fbox{$\times$},
  hex-digits = block,

]{Latin Modern Sans}

\newpage
